description: Returns the authenticated user's own account: id, username, email, email and KYC status, whether real-money trading is enabled for the public API (public_api_real_money_enabled), wager counts, trading-relevant settings and a `wallet` object with the balance in each currency. Use it to answer who the user is, whether real money can be traded through the API, or for a quick balance snapshot; use get_balances to read one currency's balance. Read-only.
name: get_user_profile
title: Get my profile
